note: Rows of public procurement forms, word for word, each naming the synthetic Answers of recall-set.json it must reach. Each form was walked in its own order. A row is here when a person filling in the form would answer it from an Answer, and it names every Answer they would answer it from: a row about the product names the account-wide Answer and each module's. A row no Answer answers is left out, and so is a row that asks only for what the row before it left out. A cloud security principle names the Answers of the G-Cloud rows in the section G-Cloud gives that principle. No row was taken or left for the words it shares with an Answer, and none names a collection. Only white space, markup and footnote marks differ from the form: a row of the Selection Questionnaire is its question cell, cut after the last whole line that keeps it within find's 500 characters, and a principle is its heading without its number. A row whose Answers all sit in one group of the recall set carries that group as its collection, so the measure can ask it with the collection named. The column was added on 13/10/2026, after the first figure was read, and no question and no list of Answers changed with it. An independent reading of the mappings that day held 71 sound and would change 15, adding an Answer to ten rows and taking one or more from five. None of those changes is applied here: the rows name what they named before any figure was known.
